openQuestions.question: The spec does not say how long the hand-over takes inside each 2 s turn ('one rises to 1.4 while the previous falls to 0.25').
openQuestions.default: A 0.8 s easeInOutCubic crossfade at the start of each turn, then a 1.2 s hold, so one screen reads as lit at a time; above the 0.5 s glow ramp floor.

openQuestions.question: EXPERIENCE §4 asks for the reduced-motion pose under ?test=1, but the exhibit cannot tell ?test=1 from an idle stop (runtime.motion is false for both), and snapping to 0.8 on an idle stop would jump.
openQuestions.default: For the first second the clock blends from the 0.8 rest pose into the loop, so the clock at 0 (?test=1, tier low) is the rest pose; reduced motion pins 0.8; an idle stop freezes mid-turn (WP-16 ruling). One motion, one clock.

openQuestions.question: 'Facing the center' is read as screens facing the table center (front edge inward, hinge outward). Azimuths start at 0 degrees (+X), not 90, so two back screens face the camera and the cube shows between the two front laptops.
openQuestions.default: Built that way; the alternative (screens facing outward) would hide the back screens behind their lids.

openQuestions.question: At the specified dimensions the object fills only the lower 40% of the slot (lid tops at y 0.26), so the case reads airy; in the 320 px thumbnail the laptops are small but distinct.
openQuestions.default: Built exactly to EXPERIENCE §4.8 (top surface at y 0.20); flagged as G3 polish. Raising the table would be a spec change.
